title: Lumen release manifest
description: What install.sh and the lumenc/candela self-updaters read to find, verify, and unpack a release. Generated at release time by tools/make-manifest.sh in the lumen repo. manifest.json is the current release; every release also stays available as manifest-<version>.json beside it, which is what install.sh --version fetches.

schema_version.description: Manifest format. An installer refuses a manifest it does not understand.

generated.description: When the manifest was built, in UTC.

base_url.description: Host every download URL starts with. Installers rewrite this prefix when pointed at a mirror.

components.description: Separately installable pieces of the toolchain, keyed by the name used in the --components spec.

description.description: One line shown in the installer prompt.

default.description: Whether a plain install includes this component.

artifact.description: One archive. It holds the tree to install: executables in bin/, libraries in lib/.

version.description: Version of this component, which can trail the release version.

sha256.description: Digest of the archive. Installers verify it before unpacking.

size.description: Archive size in bytes, shown in the installer prompt.
